_second_witness: ⭐ EVERY column in this range was read on TWO witnesses: the on-disk archive.org PDF and the Gallica IIIF copy (ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w, f = (column + 1) / 2). That was not belt-and-braces: the archive.org copy of these eight pages is heavily over-inked and it MANUFACTURED twelve letter-level divergences that Gallica refuted (see the work's cruces-0036.md §5.0). No single-witness letter call in cols 0160-0173 should be trusted.
